item.title: Clawdbot Chaos: A Forced Rebrand, Crypto Scam and 24-Hour Meltdown
item.description: Scammers exploited a brief gap amid a trademark dispute to launch meme coin CLAWD, briefly inflate it to $16 million, and turn a viral AI project into a cautionary tale.

item.title: Coinbase Rolls Out Kalshi-Powered Prediction Markets Across United States
item.description: Leading American crypto exchange Coinbase has launched its own prediction markets offering, powered by Kalshi.

item.title: Japanese Banking Giant’s Crypto Subsidiary Applies for US Banking Charter
item.description: A Swiss subsidiary of Japanese investment banking giant Nomura is the latest crypto firm to seek a U.S. national bank charter from the OCC.

item.title: Bitcoin Backers, Cypherpunks Sour on Trump Following Fatal Minneapolis Shooting
item.description: Some members of the crypto industry are publicly distancing themselves from President Trump after the killing of Alex Pretti—and the White House's comments around it.

item.title: Gemini Launches Zcash Credit Card That Pays ZEC Rewards
item.description: Publicly traded crypto exchange Gemini launched a new Zcash-themed credit card that pays ZEC rewards to holders.

item.title: OpenAI Rolls Out Free Science Platform Prism as Experts Warn of Privacy Concerns
item.description: Prism aims to move ChatGPT into scientific writing as OpenAI signals plans to share in future profits. Some are warning against its pitfalls.

item.title: SEC Says Tokenized Assets Are Securities First, Technology Second
item.description: The SEC said Wednesday blockchain-based recordkeeping does not alter investor protections, while leaving unresolved how crypto-native products fit into existing law.

item.title: Brave Bets on Social Heist Puzzles to Pull Players Into Its Gaming Push
item.description: The privacy-focused browser developer is testing whether gamified competition can pull new users into Web3 gaming.

item.title: Australia Fines Qoin Wallet Operator $14 Million for Unlicensed Activity
item.description: The ruling marks one of the largest court-imposed penalties yet tied to crypto marketing practices in Australia.

item.title: Robinhood CEO Says GameStop Incident Was a Wake-Up Call for Tokenization
item.description: Robinhood is once again blaming the GameStop crisis on infrastructure, but experts point to undercapitalization.
